root.label: DOJ charges John Anthony Proia III with harassing Katie Miller

events.label: DOJ charges John Anthony Proia III with harassing Katie Miller

slots.name: charge status
slots.sentence: Federal authorities on Thursday charged a Boston-area man with harassing Katie Miller, the conservative podcaster and wife of senior White House aide Stephen Miller, in a case that sparked a heated debate among prosecutors and within the FBI.

slots.name: defendant age
slots.sentence: John Anthony Proia III, 41, was arrested and charged with stalking over allegations that he called, texted and left voicemails with “disturbing messages” about the victim, who was described as a former political adviser, and her husband, who is currently a high-level federal government employee, the Justice Department said in a news release.

slots.name: indictment count
slots.sentence: Proia was indicted by a federal grand jury in Boston on Thursday on one count of cyberstalking after being arrested earlier in the day.

slots.name: contact count
slots.sentence: He is alleged to have contacted the former political adviser more than 40 times in less than two months, according to the Justice Department.

slots.name: calls and texts
slots.sentence: The indictment charges John Anthony Proia III, 41, of Waltham, with cyberstalking a "former political advisor and prominent member of the Republican party" who is married to a "high-level federal government employee" with more than 40 calls and texts between August and September of this year, the Justice Department said.

slots.name: investigation requests
slots.sentence: This is at least the second time Katie Miller has asked the FBI to investigate alleged threats or harassment.

slots.name: plea status
slots.sentence: Proia, who comes from the Boston suburb Waltham, pleaded not guilty to the felony charge before a magistrate judge in an initial court appearance.

slots.name: offense date range
slots.sentence: The defendant is also accused of sending disturbing messages to Miller’s parents during the August-to-September time frame cited in court documents.

slots.name: indictment date
slots.sentence: A Massachusetts man was indicted on Thursday for allegedly cyberstalking podcaster Katie Miller, who is married to White House deputy chief of staff for policy Stephen Miller, according to the Justice Department and sources familiar with the matter.

slots.name: court appearance date
slots.sentence: Proia was due to appear in federal court at 5 p.m. on Thursday.

slots.name: arrest date
slots.sentence: A Massachusetts man was arrested Thursday and charged with cyberstalking conservative podcaster Katie Miller, the wife of White House deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller, after prosecutors alleged that he repeatedly called and texted her for weeks.
